Idrottsföreningen Sundsvall | founded = {{Start date and years ago|1903|8|25|df=y}} | chairman = | mgrtitle = Head coach | manager = [[Per Joar Hansen]] | league = [[Superettan]] | season = [[2025 Superettan|2025]] | position = Superettan, 11th of 16 | current = 2024 GIF Sundsvall season | website = {{URL|https://www.gifsundsvall.se/}} |pattern_la1=_adidastirocm26tr |pattern_b1=_adidastirocm26tr |pattern_ra1=_adidastirocm26tr |pattern_sh1=_gif26h |leftarm1=0000ff |body1=0000ff |rightarm1=0000ff |shorts1=FFFFFF |socks1=0000ff |pattern_la2=_gif26a |pattern_b2=_gif26a |pattern_ra2=_gif26a |pattern_sh2=_gif26h |leftarm2=FFFFFF |body2=FFFFFF |rightarm2=FFFFFF |shorts2=FFFFFF |socks2=FFFFFF |body3= |leftarm3= |rightarm3= |shorts3= |socks3= |pattern_b3= |pattern_sh3= |pattern_so1= |pattern_so2= |pattern_so3= }} '''Gymnastik- och Idrottsföreningen Sundsvall''', more commonly known as '''GIF Sundsvall''' ({{IPA|sv|ˈɡɪfː ˈsɵ̂nː(d)sval}}),{{cite book|url=https://runeberg.org/ortnamn/0027.html|author1=Jöran Sahlgren|author2=Gösta Bergman|title=Svenska ortnamn med uttalsuppgifter|language=sv|year=1979|page=23|access-date=2019-04-26|archive-date=2020-03-29|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200329143024/http://runeberg.org/ortnamn/0027.html|url-status=live}} '''Giffarna''' or simply '''Sundsvall''', is a Swedish professional [[association football|football club]] based in [[Sundsvall]]. The club is affiliated with [[Medelpads Fotbollförbund]] and plays its home games at [[NP3 Arena (Sundsvall)|NP3 Arena]] with a capacity of roughly 8,000 spectators.{{cite web |url= https://svenskfotboll.se/svensk-fotboll/om-svff/distrikten/?ffid=11 |title= Kontaktuppgifter och tävlingar – Medelpads Fotbollförbund – Svenskfotboll.se |access-date= 2011-01-12 |archive-date= 2011-12-07 |archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20111207132940/http://svenskfotboll.se/svensk-fotboll/om-svff/distrikten/?ffid=11 |url-status= live }} Formed on 25 August 1903, the club has played 19 seasons in Sweden's highest football league [[Allsvenskan]], the club's first season in the league was in [[1965 Allsvenskan|1965]]. GIF Sundsvall is placed twenty-second in the overall Allsvenskan table [[Allsvenskan#All-time Allsvenskan table|maratontabellen]]. The club colours, reflected in their crest and kit, are blue, yellow and white. Nevertheless, white is not articulately present in today's kit it has a strong history within the club."}}
